messages:
Alex (Product): Quick heads-up — rolling Hosted API: Tool-calling + Streaming v1 to GA today at 14:00 PT. This release stabilizes structured tool-calling schemas and streaming chunked responses. Docs + migration guide: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/toolcall-streaming-v1 :tada:

Alex (Product): Breaking note: old `tool_call_v0` will be deprecated in 60 days. We provide an automatic shim for most simple usages but teams should migrate to v1 to get stable schema checks and fewer runtime errors.

Alex (Product): Minimal curl example (streaming chunks, JSON schema enforcement):
```bash
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-alpha","input":"run:weather_check","tool_call":{"name":"weather","args_schema":{"city":"string"}}}'
```

Maria (DevEx): Will we push SDK updates the same day? Customers will expect patched helpers.

Alex (Product): Yes — DevEx SDKs v1.2.0 will land tonight with a `ToolCallV1` helper and a `--legacy-mapping` opt-in for quick lifts. Migration snippets will be in the doc above.

Jess (Eng): Rollout plan? full-traffic cutoff? any force-migration?

Alex (Product): Canary 10% for 2 hours, then 50% for 1 hour, then 100% if metrics look good. No forced migration; deprecation timer starts at GA date. We'll send a follow-up email 30d & 7d before shutdown. :eyes:

Sam (SRE): I'll add a per-route latency + error budget dashboard and a PagerDuty rule if tool-schema validation errors spike > 5% for 5m. Also tagging SLOs for streaming tail latency.

Olivia (Legal): Heads-up — does this change any data handling? If schema includes PII fields, we need to ensure KMS/HSM logging flags are applied for Private customers. Otherwise fine.

Alex (Product): Good call. Default audit-logging will be enabled for Private and Dedicated; Hosted customers can opt into extended audit logs. Update posted to the compliance playbook.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started for toolcall-streaming-v1 on hosted-prod (10% traffic) — id: deploy_2026_04_21_1871234567

ops-bot: health-checks: all canary instances reporting healthy. 0 schema-mismatch errors in first 5m.

Maria (DevEx): Will surface a short changelog blurb and examples in the Release Notes channel. Can someone drop a 1-paragraph customer-facing summary?

Alex (Product): I'll draft a short blurb and post in #release-notes + product-blog later today. TL;DR: more reliable tool-calls, streaming improvements, and a 60-day deprecation for v0. :shipit:

Jess (Eng): If anyone sees odd validator regressions, ping me directly. Planning a quick hotfix branch ready if needed.

Sam (SRE): Logged: incident runbook updated under infra/streaming-toolcall.

Alex (Product): Thanks team — I'll follow up with the migration checklist and a pinned doc in this thread.
